summary: Independently reconciled the empty proposal and functionality document against canonical and rendered targcont.c lines 1-14 and targcont.h lines 1-9. The call order, parameterless DSError interface, unconditional kNoError return on normal completion, lack of local branching/error inspection, and return-dependent EXI2 reacquisition match. Rendered names are unchanged. Inherit all seven retained facts and both retained links without overrides; upstream reports no contradictions or unresolved items. No compiled-layout or callee-internal claims are added.
